core_obligations: Reduce to the fibre product (proof lines 1469-1480): the pullback of the class of the diagonal of the base is the class of the fibre product, and the diagonal of the projective bundle lies inside that fibre product; since capping with Chern classes commutes with proper pushforward, it suffices to compute the class of the diagonal inside the fibre product.

Identify the diagonal as a zero scheme (proof lines 1480-1503): composing the natural map from the tensor product of the pullbacks of the tautological subbundle and the twisted structure sheaf into the structure sheaf of the fibre product, whose target is the pullback of the evaluation map, gives a map from a locally free module of rank one less than the rank; a local calculation shows that this map vanishes exactly along the diagonal, so the class of the diagonal is the top Chern class of the dual of that module.

Read off the formula (proof lines 1503-1517): applying the formula for the Chern classes of a tensor product with an invertible module to the top Chern class obtained above produces exactly the displayed sum over binomial coefficients, which proves the statement.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the fibre product over the base by compatibility of capping with pushforward.
Exhibit the diagonal as the zero scheme of a map from a locally free module.
Apply the Chern class formula for tensor products with invertible modules.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves a closed formula for the class of the diagonal of a projective bundle in terms of the Chern classes of the tautological subbundle and of the twist, capped with the pullback of the class of the diagonal of the base (statement lines 1465-1477). The proof (proof lines 1478-1517) reduces to the fibre product, exhibits the diagonal as the zero scheme of a map from a locally free module, and applies the Chern class formula for twistings. H3: a reduction with an explicit formula, written out in full.
